workflow_plan.goal: Create a choropleth map of hospital counts across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Constrain census tracts to Centre County coverage
workflow_steps.purpose: Prepare census tract polygons as the analytical mapping units and constrain them using the supplied Centre County subdivision coverage.
workflow_steps.instructions: Clip the census tract polygons to the supplied Centre County subdivision coverage. Preserve the tract attributes and output a GeoPackage polygon layer.

workflow_steps.title: Count hospitals by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Count hospital point features within each Centre County census tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Count the hospital point features from input_1 within the prepared census tract polygons. Write the resulting counts to the output field hospital_count and preserve the polygon geometries and attributes.

workflow_steps.title: Map hospital counts by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Produce the requested choropleth map of hospital counts across Centre County.
workflow_steps.instructions: Generate an interactive HTML choropleth from the hospital_counts_by_tract GeoPackage layer, using hospital_count as the mapped attribute and embedding source and CRS verification metadata.
